LIBRARY RESOURCES

Resources for Learning, Teaching and Research

Discover the library's collections, facilities and information resources that support the academic community of Maharajah Government Sanskrit College.

ABOUT THE LIBRARY

A Centre for Learning and Knowledge

Maharajah Government Sanskrit College Library, Vizianagaram, was established in 1860 by the Pusapati maharajahs of Vizianagaram. The library supports learning, teaching and research by providing access to books, reference materials, newspapers, journals and electronic resources.

With approximately 10,000 books and a range of digital resources, the library serves students, faculty members and former students/alumni.

🎯

Mission

To provide timely, equitable and user-friendly access to quality information resources and library services, supporting academic learning, teaching, research and lifelong learning.

🔭

Vision

To develop a modern, accessible and technology-enabled academic library that connects users with reliable knowledge resources while preserving the institution's rich intellectual and cultural heritage.

COLLECTIONS

Library Collections and Information Resources

The library provides a combination of print and electronic resources for academic use.

📚

Books

Approximately 10,000 books covering academic subjects and areas relevant to the college community.

📖

Reference Collection

Reference materials that assist users in locating factual, subject-specific and supporting information.

📰

Newspapers & Journals

Newspapers, magazines and journals supporting current awareness, study and academic information needs.

💻

Digital Resources

E-books, e-journals, online databases, N-LIST, INFLIBNET resources, Shodhganga, digital library and ONOS.

FACILITIES

Library Facilities

The library provides a comfortable and supportive environment for reading, learning and information access.

📖

Reading Hall

A dedicated reading hall with seating capacity for approximately 40 students.

🔎

Reference Section

A separate reference section for consultation of useful reference and academic materials.

🗄️

Stack / Collection Area

Organised collection space for accessing and maintaining the library's book resources.

🖥️

Computer & Internet

Computer and internet facilities to support electronic information access and academic work.

📶

Wi-Fi

Wi-Fi facility supporting convenient access to electronic and online academic resources.

♿

Accessibility

Accessibility facilities intended to make library services easier to use for all users.
